description: This Java source file defines the ExtendedDevice class, which models a tuple of devices including an authenticated device and an optional origin device, used within the CoAP adapter of the Eclipse Hono project. It provides methods for instantiation and string representation, encapsulating device relationship data.

classes.name: ExtendedDevice
classes.description: A class representing a tuple of devices, including an authenticated device and an origin device, used in CoAP communication within the Hono framework.

methods.name: ExtendedDevice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ExtendedDevice with an authenticated device and an origin device.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the device tuple, indicating whether devices are identical or the origin device via the authenticated device.
